This security system continuously monitors card transactions to detect and prevent fraudulent activities before they impact customers' accounts. The protection works around the clock to safeguard cardholders during all transactions, whether online or in-person. This feature provides peace of mind to cardholders knowing their spending is protected by sophisticated security systems that can quickly identify unusual patterns and potentially fraudulent transactions.

promotions.description: EleBank offers customers the convenience of opening an account in as little as 5 minutes directly from their mobile device. This streamlined digital onboarding process allows customers to quickly access EleBank's full range of banking services without visiting a physical branch. The entire application process is handled through the mobile app, utilizing advanced data technology to verify identity and establish accounts efficiently. This service is available 24/7, allowing customers to open accounts at their convenience any time of day.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy zero account fees and no minimum balance requirements
promotions.description: EleBank offers accounts with no account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements. This feature allows customers to maintain accounts without worrying about monthly maintenance charges or maintaining minimum balances to avoid fees. The zero-fee structure applies to all standard EleBank accounts, making banking more accessible and economical for everyone. Customers can open and maintain accounts with any balance amount without incurring penalties or charges, reflecting EleBank's commitment to providing inclusive financial services regardless of account balance.

promotions.title: EleBank Personal Loan with Preferential Interest Rates
promotions.highlight: 💸 Borrow up to 12 times your monthly salary or HKD1,000,000
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with amounts up to 12 times the customer's monthly salary or HKD1,000,000, whichever is lower. The loan approval process can be completed as quickly as 5 minutes from application to fund disbursement, providing a fast solution for customers needing immediate financing. The actual annual percentage rate (APR) ranges from 7.43% to 35.05%, with repayment periods available from 6 to 60 months. EleBank provides customized interest rates based on individual customer profiles, with the exact rate determined during the approval process.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Hold multiple currencies in one flexible savings account with no minimum balance
promotions.description: EleBank offers a multi-currency savings account that supports multiple currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB without minimum balance requirements. This flexible account allows customers to hold funds in different currencies simultaneously, facilitating easy management of international finances. The account provides 24/7 access to funds and supports immediate transfers between different currency wallets. This is ideal for customers who regularly deal with multiple currencies, travel internationally, or want to diversify their cash holdings across different currencies without maintaining separate accounts.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit with Interest Rate Boost Coupons
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhance your time deposit returns with interest rate boosters
promotions.description: EleBank provides flexible time deposit options with the ability to enhance returns through interest rate boosters. Customers can open time deposits 24/7 through the mobile app with a variety of term options to suit their needs. The time deposit accounts can be supplemented with interest rate boosters to earn additional returns on deposits. This service allows customers to maximize their savings while maintaining the security of a time deposit account. The flexible terms make it easy to align deposit maturity with financial goals or anticipated cash needs.

promotions.title: EleBank Money Safe Anti-Fraud Protection Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced account protection with fraud prevention features while earning interest
promotions.description: EleBank's Money Safe feature provides enhanced protection against fraud while still allowing customers to earn interest on their funds. This security measure, introduced in partnership with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, requires in-person verification for unlocking funds, adding an extra layer of security against unauthorized access or fraudulent transfers. Customers can still earn the same interest rates as regular savings or time deposit accounts while their funds are protected. This feature is particularly valuable in the current environment of sophisticated financial scams, giving customers peace of mind about their deposits.

promotions.title: 24/7 Online Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕒 Access banking services anytime with 24/7 online banking
promotions.description: EleBank provides round-the-clock online banking services to customers through its mobile app and online platform. Customers can perform a wide range of banking transactions at any time of day or night, including transfers, deposits, loan applications, and foreign currency exchange. The service includes 24-hour customer service support through a dedicated hotline for any assistance needed. This always-on digital banking experience ensures customers have continuous access to their accounts and banking needs regardless of traditional banking hours.

This offer is available for both new and existing WeLab Bank customers.

After accepting the recommendation, the system will make the initial investment and continue with automated monthly investments based on the customer's settings. The service provides ongoing notifications about investment progress and allows customers to monitor and adjust their goals as needed. This is not a discretionary asset management service, and the recommendations do not guarantee investment outcomes.

The cash reward will be credited to the customer's Core Account by June 30, 2026.

The service includes Payment Connect for real-time, zero-fee transfers between Chinese Mainland and Hong Kong, Wise integration for express HKD remittances that arrive faster than traditional methods, and SWIFT transfers directly to 140+ countries and regions with zero ZA Bank fees. These global transfer options are available to all ZA Bank account holders. Users can initiate transfers through the ZA Bank app, selecting their preferred method based on destination, speed requirements, and cost considerations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free from ZA Bank side; correspondent banks may charge fees

promotions.title: Customer Referral Rewards Program for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 👫 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to ZA Bank
promotions.description: Refer friends to open a ZA Bank account using your unique invitation code to earn various rewards. The campaign includes multiple tiers of rewards: Top 20 referrers in each of the 9 campaign phases can earn up to HKD 10,000 cash reward. You also earn cash rewards for each successful referral who deposits ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening. Additional rewards are available when your referred friends maintain deposits, funds, and stocks reaching HKD 1,000 in total balance. Rewards will be distributed within 30 working days after meeting the conditions.
promotions.quota: Multiple rewards available based on number of successful referrals

promotions.title: ZA Bank Instant Loan Approval in as Fast as 90 Seconds
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Get loan approval results in as fast as 90 seconds
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined loan application process with preliminary approval results available in as fast as 90 seconds for new customers. The service provides loans of up to HKD 1,000,000 with an annualized percentage rate as low as 1.30%. ZA Bank offers a range of loan products including Instalment Loan, Card Statement Instalment, and Debt Consolidation to meet different financial needs. The bank regularly introduces special loan deals to help reduce borrowing costs further. Eligible applicants must be Hong Kong ID holders aged 18 or above with a monthly income of at least HKD 8,000.
promotions.cost: Interest rates vary based on credit assessment

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan with Cash Reward up to HKD 2,000
promotions.highlight: 💰 Get up to HKD 2,000 cash reward when clearing your credit card balances
promotions.description: Apply for ZA Card Statement Instalment Program and enter promo code [SURPRISE] to receive cash rewards of up to HKD 2,000. This offer is available for both new and existing customers who successfully apply and complete the cooling-off period of 7 days. The reward amount varies based on the loan amount: HKD 588 for loans between HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for loans between HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans of HKD 800,000 or above with a repayment period of 18 months or more. The promotion code must be entered during the loan application process and is valid for 14 days after entry.
promotions.quota: No quota mentioned, available to all eligible applicants
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 required for rewards

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary HKD 60,000 StockBack Lucky Draw
promotions.highlight: 🎉 Win a share of HKD 6 million in stock rewards with multiple ways to earn
promotions.description: Celebrate ZA Bank's 6th anniversary with a multi-faceted StockBack campaign offering stock rewards worth up to HKD 6 million. The campaign includes six components: login draws for prizes up to HKD 60,000 (with double chances for users whose age ends with '6'), 6% StockBack cashback at all coffee merchants (increased to 12% at designated merchants) with a cap of HKD 50 per user, task completion rewards, new user bonuses, and a StockBack leaderboard with prizes including exclusive metal cards for top performers. Users need a valid ZA Card and investment account to receive rewards. Stock selections must be completed within 48 hours of receiving the StockBack opportunity.
promotions.quota: Various limits apply to different components of the campaign
promotions.cost: Free participation, spending required for some rewards

promotions.title: ZA Bank Stock PowerDraw Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Get free stocks through the Stock PowerDraw with every eligible stock purchase
promotions.description: Earn a chance to win stocks through the Stock PowerDraw each time you complete a purchase transaction in stocks during the promotion period. Each PowerDraw chance is valid for 24 hours from issuance and allows users to win 'Designated Stock Redemption Coupons' for stocks ranked in the top 100 by market value in the US stock market. To qualify, the platform fee for US stock purchases must be at least USD 2 per transaction or HKD 20 per transaction for Hong Kong stocks. Users must have ZA Bank App version 3.8.9 or above to be eligible for the Stock PowerDraw chance.
promotions.quota: One Stock PowerDraw chance per eligible stock purchase
promotions.cost: Minimum platform fee of USD 2 for US stocks or HKD 20 for HK stocks per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Card PowerDraw
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Win up to 200% rebate on your spending through PowerDraw
promotions.description: ZA Card PowerDraw gives cardholders a chance to win up to a 200% rebate on their spending. Each eligible transaction provides an opportunity to participate in the PowerDraw, where users can win varying percentages of their transaction amount back as rewards. The program also features a Millionaire PowerDraw where users can receive MillionTix for a chance to share in a HKD 1 million prize pool. The PowerDraw feature is automatically available to all ZA Card users without additional registration. Simply make purchases with your ZA Card to become eligible for each PowerDraw chance.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Card holders

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at 3,000+ Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💵 Withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong with the ZA Card. This service is available to all ZA Card holders at any time, providing convenient access to cash throughout Hong Kong without incurring any withdrawal fees. The free withdrawal service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to providing convenient banking services. Overseas cash withdrawals may still incur handling fees, but local withdrawals are completely free of charge.

promotions.title: Stock Trading with Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📊 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage, 0 custody fees, and low platform fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers stock trading with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees for all customers. Platform fees are as low as USD 1.99 for US stocks and HKD 18 per transaction for Hong Kong stocks. Customers can also participate in the StockBack program, which allows them to earn free stocks after successfully purchasing stocks through the platform. The service provides a cost-effective way to trade stocks directly from the ZA Bank app, making it accessible to both beginner and experienced investors. Users need to have an active investment account with stock trading services enabled to access these benefits.
promotions.cost: Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan with Promotion Code SURPRISE
promotions.highlight: 💸 Get up to HKD 2,000 cash reward with promo code SURPRISE
promotions.description: The ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan offers consolidation of credit card debt with promotional cash rewards. Customers who input the promo code 'SURPRISE' when applying for the instalment plan and successfully draw funds with a repayment period of 18 months or more can receive cash rewards up to HKD 2,000. The reward amount varies based on the loan amount: HKD 588 for loans of HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for loans of HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans of HKD 800,000 or above. The cash reward will be issued after the 7-day cooling-off period, and the promotion code is valid for 14 days after input.
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 for rewards

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Leaderboard Metal Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Win a StockBack x ZA Card metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: The StockBack Leaderboard promotion runs in three phases during ZA Bank's 6th Anniversary campaign. Participants earn StockBack points by completing designated ZA Quest tasks, using ZA Card with the StockBack reward plan, and receiving designated stock exchange coupons through the 'stock lucky draw'. The top 1,000 participants with the highest accumulated points in each phase receive rewards: the top 60 receive a StockBack x ZA Card metal card (valued at HKD 1,000), while places 61-1,000 receive priority access to the StockBack x ZA Card physical card experience. Each participant can receive the leaderboard reward only once during the entire promotion period. The metal card is an exclusive premium offering not available through standard channels.
promotions.quota: Top 60 participants per phase for metal card, top 61-1,000 for priority card access
promotions.cost: Must accumulate StockBack points through eligible activities

promotions.title: Year-Round Travel Offers with ZA Card
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Exclusive travel discounts for ZA Card holders
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers year-round travel promotions for ZA Card holders, providing special discounts on travel-related purchases. These offers cover various travel services and destinations, giving cardholders access to preferential rates throughout the year. The promotion aims to enhance the travel experience while providing savings for ZA Bank customers.
promotions.cost: Card spending on travel-related services required

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: PowerDraw Up to 200% Rebate + Million Dollar Prize Pool
promotions.highlight: 💰 Win up to 200% rebate and share HKD 1 million prize pool
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw to win up to 200% rebate on purchases. Additionally, customers receive MillionTix through PowerDraw for a chance to share in a prize pool of HKD 1 million. This promotion encourages spending with ZA Card to maximize chances of winning substantial cashback and prizes.
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card for eligible transactions

promotions.title: New Customer HKD 2,026 Reward Package and 2.5% StockBack
promotions.highlight: 💰 New customers earn 2.5% stock rewards on first HKD 10,000 spending
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can enjoy enhanced 2.5% StockBack rewards on their first HKD 10,000 of eligible spending within 30 days of account opening. This combines the standard 1.5% stock rebate with an additional 1% bonus for new users. Customers must select the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan to qualify for this elevated stock reward rate on initial card spending.
promotions.quota: New users who have never held any ZA Bank products or services
promotions.cost: Must use ZA Card and select StockBack reward plan

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a ZA Bank account in as little as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined digital account opening process that can be completed in as little as 2 minutes under ideal circumstances. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors currently in Hong Kong. The efficient onboarding process is part of ZA Bank's core digital banking features designed to provide immediate access to banking services.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount

promotions.title: Loan Approval in as Fast as 90 Seconds
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Loan approval results in as fast as 90 seconds
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers fast loan approval with initial results available in as little as 90 seconds. Loans of up to HKD 1,000,000 are available with rates as low as 1.30% annualized percentage rate, depending on credit assessment.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured via smartphone in as little as 3 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes via smartphone. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) with a simplified claims process.

promotions.title: Zero Deposit Requirement for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💸 Open an account with zero deposit requirement
promotions.description: ZA Bank allows both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong to open a bank account online with no minimum deposit requirement. This zero-barrier entry makes banking accessible to everyone regardless of their initial deposit amount.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: 24x7 Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Exchange currencies anytime with 24/7 availability
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can exchange between 11 currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates. This allows users to seize market opportunities at any time and grow their wealth through flexible currency exchange.

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Metal Card Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💳 Win an exclusive metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: Top 60 users with the highest StockBack points in each of three phases during the 6th anniversary promotion will receive a premium StockBack x ZA Card metal card valued at HKD 1,000.
promotions.quota: Top 60 users per phase; Maximum one card per user during promotion
promotions.cost: Free, but requires active participation in StockBack activities

promotions.title: 30-Day Delayed Repayment for Credit Card Statement Instalment
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Start repayment 30 days after successful application
promotions.description: After successfully drawing from the ZA Card Statement Installment Plan, users can start their first repayment after 30 days. This provides users breathing room before beginning repayment.
promotions.cost: Apply for ZA Card Statement Installment Plan

promotions.title: Loan Applications for Up to 21x Monthly Salary
promotions.highlight: 💰 Borrow up to 21 times your monthly salary
promotions.description: Eligible customers can apply for loan amounts of up to 21 times their monthly salary. This applies to products like the Credit Card Statement Instalment Plan, allowing for greater financial flexibility and cash flow management.

promotions.title: New Account Bonus - Fund Holding Rebate Vouchers
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Receive HKD 800 in fund holding rebate vouchers
promotions.description: New customers who open accounts using a referral code receive HKD 800 in fund holding rebate vouchers (one HKD 780 voucher and one HKD 20 voucher). Vouchers are valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used toward fund investments.
promotions.quota: New customers referred through the MGM program

promotions.title: ZA Card with No Annual or Hidden Fees
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Coffee Merchant Promotion
promotions.highlight: ☕ 6% stock rewards at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: Customers can earn 6% stock rewards on eligible transactions at all local coffee merchants when spending with their ZA Card during the promotion period. Maximum reward is capped at HKD 50 per customer combining both 6% and 12% offers.
promotions.quota: Maximum HKD 50 combined reward per customer

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💵 Free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Card holders can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs throughout Hong Kong. This permanent feature allows customers to access their money without incurring withdrawal fees at supported ATMs.

promotions.title: Open an Account in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick and easy account opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as fast as 2 minutes when no extra information is required. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: ZA Credit Loan Referral Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Invite friends to apply for loans at ZA Bank and receive cash rewards up to HKD 900 when they successfully take out a loan. The more friends you refer, the more rewards you can earn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance in 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: Complete the insurance application process in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone. Choose from various insurance products including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) options.
promotions.cost: Insurance premiums vary by product and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: Trade stocks with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Trade directly with your HKD or USD deposits in your ZA Bank account.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank investment account holders
promotions.cost: Platform fee starting from USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New Customer Welcome Reward and StockBack Bonus
promotions.highlight: 🔥 New users enjoy additional 1% stock rewards for a total of 2.5% cashback
promotions.description: New ZA Bank users can enjoy an additional 1% stock rewards on their first HKD 10,000 of eligible spending within 30 days of account opening. This bonus stacks with the 1.5% regular stock rewards for a total of 2.5% stock cashback.
promotions.quota: New users only, for the first HKD 10,000 of eligible transactions
promotions.cost: Minimum transaction amount of HKD 10 required

promotions.title: 0 Brokerage and 0 Custody Fee Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 🏦 0 commission and 0 custody fees on all HK stock trades
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18 per transaction. This permanent feature allows unlimited trading without paying traditional brokerage commissions, significantly reducing trading costs.
promotions.quota: All users with active stock trading accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee from HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Platform Fee for New Crypto Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 $0 platform fee for crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy $0 platform fee for cryptocurrency trading for the first 90 days after account opening. Trade 24/7 directly with HKD or USD deposits.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Hong Kong Stocks Trading Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards for new stock trading customers
promotions.description: New customers who activate Hong Kong stocks trading can receive up to HKD 500 cash rewards through ZA Quest, plus up to HKD 1,000 cash rebate when buying stocks. Enjoy 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.

promotions.title: Hong Kong's No.1 Digital Bank
promotions.highlight: 🏆 First digital bank in Hong Kong with highest user base and deposits
promotions.description: As the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong, ZA Bank had the highest number of users and customer deposits among the city's eight digital banks as of 30 June 2024. ZA Bank offers 24x7 banking services with convenient digital features.

promotions.title: Refer a Friend for Loan Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 900 by referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Existing customers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards for successfully referring friends who take out loans with ZA Bank. This incentive program rewards customers for bringing in new loan customers.
promotions.quota: All existing ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Monthly Fee Savings on Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💰 Save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading fees compared to traditional brokers
promotions.description: ZA Bank's stock trading service can save customers up to HKD 1,000 in monthly fees compared to traditional brokers. This calculation is based on making one trade per trading day (approximately 20 trades per month) with zero commission, zero custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.
promotions.cost: Platform fees apply (from HKD 18 per transaction)

promotions.title: 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🧑‍💼 Round-the-clock customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24x7 customer service support to all users. Banking services are always available regardless of time of day, with full customer service access.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Program - Referrer Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's customer referral program rewards users for referring friends to open accounts. Referrers can earn various rewards based on the number of successful referrals, with top referrers eligible for up to HKD 10,000 per phase across 9 phases of the campaign.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Brokerage & 0% Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees for Hong Kong stocks
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero commission and zero custody fees. Platform fee is as low as HKD 18 per transaction, allowing users to save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading costs compared to traditional brokers.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank users with activated stock trading services
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New User HKD 500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 500 cash reward when opening a new account
promotions.description: Selected customers can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards when opening a new ZA Bank account. Customers can complete specific tasks in ZA Quest after successful account opening to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: Selected new customers only; not applicable to customers who opened accounts through referral programs or have received other new customer gifts

promotions.title: New Account HKD 2,026 Welcome Reward
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Get rewards worth HKD 2,026 plus 2.5% stock rebate
promotions.description: New users who open an account using a referral code can receive rewards worth HKD 2,026 including fund position rebate vouchers and stock cash rebate vouchers. Additionally, they can enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on eligible purchases.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that allows customers to open an account in as little as 2 minutes. The service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong with zero deposit requirements.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank Payment Connect Cross-Border Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Fee-free real-time transfers between Mainland China and Hong Kong
promotions.description: Send money between Mainland China and Hong Kong in real-time with zero fees using Payment Connect. Instant cross-border transfers without any handling charges.

promotions.title: New Stock Trading Customer Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Up to HKD 1,500 in cash rewards for new stock traders
promotions.description: New users can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards for opening an account, plus up to HKD 1,000 in cash rebates for buying stocks. This offer is specifically for Hong Kong stock trading customers.
promotions.cost: Must buy stocks to qualify for portion of rewards

promotions.title: Second 20% p.a. Time Deposit for Multi-Product Usage
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Additional 20% p.a. time deposit for using multiple products
promotions.description: New referred customers who hold deposits, funds, and stocks with a total balance of at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account can receive an additional +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate booster coupon, providing a second opportunity to enjoy 20% p.a. interest.
promotions.quota: New referred customers using multiple products
